Post-selection inference

infer.Rd

This function performs a selector's default inference method. Alternative inference methods may be available via infer_*, which you should use instead if you want to do specific tuning.

Usage

infer(
  object,
  data,
  nonselection = c("ignored", "confident_nulls", "uncertain_nulls"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

a selector object

data

the data used to fit the selector

nonselection

how to handle variables the selector did not select; see infer_upsi(). Used only when the default method takes it (infer_upsi(), infer_selective()). infer_boot() and infer_pipe() have no nonselection option, so supplying it there warns and it is ignored.

...

additional arguments passed to the default infer_* method

Value

an inferrer object; see tidy.inferrer()

Details

The default method is set by the selector:

  • select_stepwise_ic(), select_ncvreg(): infer_boot()

  • select_glmnet(): infer_selective()

  • select_full_model(), select_null_model(): infer_upsi()
